ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: A high-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant central low-intensity (black) region occupying approximately 65% of the visible surface, and two distal high-intensity (white) regions occupying approximately 35%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped to the far lateral tips of both lobes. A low-intensity black wedge originates at the insertion point and expands to cover the entire medial area including the notch. The transition zone between intensities shows pixel-level mottling and irregular boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an estimated vertex angle of 105 degrees and a moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable topography; the distal portions of the trailing edge are relatively smooth, while the medial portions—specifically on the right lobe—exhibit a sequence of low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations and irregular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge geometry displays a continuous concave sweep from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, low-intensity dark pixel clusters located on the high-intensity white backgrounds of both the left and right distal lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several dark, unaligned linear pixel tracks cutting through the white pigmentation on the lateral section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular indentation and jagged contour on the medial section of the right lobe trailing edge, deviating from a uniform serration pattern.
